verdicts.reason: Both candidates are the same broken leaderboard layout. The brick photo is shrunk to a narrow sliver and the crane photo to a tiny, unreadable thumbnail. The pink brush highlight is split off from the headline into two loose streaks at the canvas edges. The body copy is tiny and illegible at this size, and most of the canvas is empty white, so it doesn't read as the original split design. The only difference is a small change in how thick the stray pink strokes are on each side; neither version is better.
